expectations: Emit the Pre-flight then run the commands (do not stop after listing boxes).
Identify as a **fresh** layout (no detection signals matched).
Name **G-PKG-NAME** as the next gate — the `src/<pkg>/` import name goes to the user via `AskUserQuestion`, with the folder name as the default, and is not picked here.

Name `python -m skore_skills scaffold --package <pkg>` as the action after G-PKG-NAME.
Mention scaffolding the default layout: `src/<pkg>/`, `journal/`, `experiments/`, `data_analysis/`, `data/`, `audit/`, `tests/smoke/`, `scratch/`, each with `README.md`.
